DL3DV-Res Benchmark
	

Project Page | Paper | GitHub
DL3DV-Res is a benchmark dataset introduced in the paper "GSFixer: Improving 3D Gaussian Splatting with Reference-Guided Video Diffusion Priors". It contains artifact frames rendered using low-quality 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) from sparse views, and is designed for evaluating 3DGS artifact restoration and sparse-view 3D reconstruction.

	
		
	
	
		Dataset Usage
	

The DL3DV-Res benchmark data can be downloaded using the following… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/flow666/DL3DV-Res_Benchmark.
reputation: A recent, specialized benchmark introduced alongside GSFixer for evaluating 3D Gaussian Splatting artifact restoration; limited adoption outside the originating research group so far.
